title: Unit Economics: drilldown tables + Top-N breakdowns (models/regions/tiers)
creator: Alicia Perez
description:
Goal
Define the UX/design spec for Top-N tables and drilldown table behavior on the internal Unit Economics dashboard (v1). This covers table layouts for breakdowns by Model, Region, and Customer Tier; sorting; comparison mode; empty/loading/error states; and guardrails to prevent misinterpretation.

Context
Primary KPI: blended $/1M output tokens. Tables are the fastest way for Finance/Product/Eng to find outliers and regressions after filtering by time range / model / region / tier.

Where this shows up
1) Dashboard overview: three Top-N tables (Models, Regions, Customer tiers)
2) Drilldown views: a full table with optional search, pagination, and secondary metrics (tokens, cost, cache/batching signals)
3) “Compare” mode: show deltas vs a previous period or another filter set

Non-goals (v1)
- Customer-level (customer_id) breakdowns (privacy/sensitivity)
- Full self-serve table customization (column picker, custom formulas)

Top-N table definition
- Default N: 10 rows (Top 10) + optional “Other / Remaining” summary row (see below)
- Each table is scoped to current global filters; each row is a dimension value (e.g., Model = llama3.1-70b-instruct@2025-01-15 + quant profile label, Region = us-east-1, Tier = dedicated)
- Each table should support:
  - Sorting by primary metric and a small set of secondary columns
  - Quick drilldown (click row) to pre-filter the main chart and open drilldown page
  - Optional comparison mode (delta column)

Table layout (Top-N on overview)
Columns (all tables)
1) Dimension value (Model / Region / Tier)
   - Truncation: 1 line + tooltip on hover
   - Secondary line for model rows only: version/quant profile if available (see “Model display rules”)
2) Blended cost: $/1M output tokens (primary)
   - Display format per DES-319: currency with 2 decimals for >= $1.00; 3 decimals for < $1.00; include unit suffix “/1M out tok”
3) Output tokens (share/volume)
   - Display as compact: 1.2B, 540M, 12.4M, etc.
4) Total attributed cost (optional in Top-N; included in drilldown tables)
   - Display as $ with compact suffix where appropriate
5) Delta vs comparison (only when compare is enabled)
   - Display as +$X.XX or -$X.XX per 1M out tok; include small % change on hover tooltip

Default sorting
- Default sort: primary metric (Blended $/1M output tokens) descending (worst first) to surface cost outliers.
- Alternate sort options: Output tokens (descending), Attributed cost (descending), Delta (descending by absolute magnitude; tie-break by primary metric).
- Tie-breakers: stable sort by dimension label (A→Z) after metric value.

“Other / Remaining” row behavior
- Shown when there are > N dimension values in result set and when “coverage” is not compromised by unknowns.
- “Other” aggregates all remaining dimension values not in top N.
- Label: “Other (remaining)”
- Tooltip: “Aggregates all dimension values not shown in Top 10.”
- If unknown/unmapped values exceed a threshold (see Data quality indicator below), show “Unknown/Unmapped” as an explicit row instead of rolling into Other.

Model display rules
- Goal: keep model rows readable without hiding key variance.
- Display name in table:
  - Primary: model_family (or marketing alias) + size + task (e.g., “Llama 3.1 70B Instruct”)
  - Secondary (small): model_version + quantization_profile (e.g., “v2025-01-15 • int8_kv_cache”) if available
- If model_version is missing, show “version unknown” (muted) and add a warning icon only when it materially impacts coverage (see indicator rules).

Comparison UX
Compare modes (v1)
- Previous period: same duration immediately preceding current range (default)
- Custom compare: user-selected second filter set (future v1.1; for v1 we only support previous period in UI, but design should not block API extension)

How compare shows up in Top-N tables
- Add a “Δ $/1M” column (or toggle to show delta inline under primary value).
- Delta is computed on the same dimension row definition.
- Handling rank changes:
  - If a dimension is in current Top 10 but not in comparison Top 10: still show its delta using comparison aggregate for that dimension (API should support this; otherwise show “—” and tooltip “Not enough data in comparison window”).
  - If a dimension existed in comparison but not current: it will not appear unless user expands to drilldown table.

Drilldown tables (full page)
- Same column set as overview plus:
  - Cache hit rate (if available in scope)
  - Batching utilization (if available)
  - Avg output length (tokens)
  - Streaming share (%, optional if implemented in v1)
- Search: client-side filter on dimension label (exact contains)
- Pagination: 25 rows per page; allow switching to 50.
- Sticky header for table when scrolling.

Row interaction
- Row click: applies that row’s dimension as an added filter and navigates to drilldown view.
- Secondary action (kebab): “Copy link to view” (creates URL with current filter state).

Data quality / confidence indicator (table-level)
- Each table shows a small indicator in header area when results may be incomplete:
  - “Partial data” when freshness/completeness is below threshold
  - “Some dimensions unknown” when unknown/unmapped share > 1% of output tokens in the table’s scope
- Interaction: hover opens popover with:
  - Coverage %
  - Missing dimensions breakdown (e.g., region unknown)
  - Link to runbook (internal) when available

Empty, loading, and error states
Loading
- Use skeleton rows (10) with shimmering placeholders.
- Keep header + column labels visible to reduce layout shift.

Empty states (distinguish)
1) No data for filters
   - Title: “No usage in selected filters”
   - Body: “Try expanding the date range or removing filters.”
   - CTA: “Reset filters” (returns to dashboard defaults)
2) Data delayed / incomplete
   - Title: “Data is still processing”
   - Body: “Unit economics data can lag by up to X hours. Check back soon.”
   - CTA: “View data freshness” (links to internal status panel / tooltip)
3) Permissions
   - Title: “You don’t have access”
   - Body: “This dashboard is restricted. Request access in #help-console.”

Error
- Inline error panel within the card with:
  - “Couldn’t load breakdown”
  - Retry button
  - Error code (copyable) for oncall

Accessibility + formatting
- Sort indicator must be keyboard navigable.
- All currency values must include unit context somewhere in the table header (avoid “$3.24” without “/1M out tok”).
- Negative deltas should not rely solely on color; include “-” and optional arrow glyph.

Open questions
- Should default sort be “worst first” (descending) or “highest volume first” (tokens)? Current recommendation: worst-first for early regression detection; Finance asked for volume as secondary.
- For Tier table, do we show enterprise vs private separately if tier mapping is incomplete? Current recommendation: show “unknown tier” explicitly if >1% token share.

Links
- PRD: internal-unit-economics-dashboard-prd (Confluence)
- UX spec: unit-economics-dashboard-drilldown-ux-spec (Confluence)
- Visualization guidelines: DES-319
- API contract sketch (Drive): unit-economics-api-contract-sketch

Acceptance criteria
- Top-N table layouts finalized for Models/Regions/Tiers with explicit column definitions and default sorting.
- Compare mode behavior specified (including missing comparison data handling).
- Empty/loading/error patterns documented and consistent with Console patterns.
- Privacy guardrail explicitly documented: no customer-identifiable breakdowns in these tables.
- Engineering sign-off that design is implementable with planned API fields (ENG-8427).
comments: 2025-02-03 Marissa Cole: Please bias the overview tables toward “what changed / what’s worst” rather than “what’s biggest”. Finance wants to catch regressions quickly; volume sorting can be a secondary toggle.

2025-02-04 Chloe Martin: For v1 API we can return Top-N plus a total row to compute “Other”. We can also return unknown/unmapped share. Rank-change handling is doable as long as the query includes explicit dimension IDs (not just top list).
2025-02-06 Felix Schneider: +1 on stable tie-break sorting; please specify whether delta sort is by signed delta or absolute delta. For debugging regressions absolute is more useful.

2025-02-07 Allison Grant: For incomplete data, we need clear UI that discourages screenshots for exec reporting when coverage < 99%. Suggest a small “Partial data” badge near the table title and include % coverage in tooltip.

2025-02-10 Nora Ahmed: Drilldown page: we should cap columns shown by default to avoid horizontal scroll. Recommend primary columns + a “Show performance signals” accordion for cache/batching columns.

2025-02-12 Alicia Perez: Updated spec: default sort worst-first; added explicit Unknown/Unmapped row rule; added skeleton loading + three empty-state variants; added table-level confidence indicator guidance per SRE feedback.

2025-02-14 Sean Gallagher: Please include a link target for runbook from the “Partial data” tooltip. We’ll wire it from the alert/runbook docs. Also, clarify copy for data delay: pipeline SLO is hourly with up to 3h backfill in incidents.

2025-02-18 Jada Williams: Model display: we need an explicit rule for showing version + quant profile; otherwise support tickets become ambiguous. The two-line model label is good. Make sure truncation has tooltip + copy action in drilldown.
status_updates: 2025-02-07 Alicia Perez: Drafted Top-N table columns, sorting, and compare behavior. Waiting on Eng confirmation for ‘Other’ + explicit dimension aggregate in compare window.
2025-02-12 Alicia Perez: Incorporated Eng/SRE feedback; added confidence indicator and unknown/unmapped treatment; clarified empty states and error panel requirements.
2025-02-18 Alicia Perez: Ready for final review with Console eng + Product; remaining open question is delta sort (signed vs absolute) and whether drilldown shows perf signals collapsed by default.
